notes: National Rail (Darwin/OpenLDBWS) is structurally catalogued here but blocked at the account level — DARWIN_LDB_TOKEN not set. Same blocker as uk-west-midlands / uk-ellesmere-port / east-midlands / south-yorkshire / north-east.

Single agency (National Rail), single mode (train). No light rail, no metro, no buses. No static GTFS exists for this feed at all — unlike East Midlands' NET or North East's Metro, there is no schedule-only fallback; this region is Darwin-or-nothing until DARWIN_LDB_TOKEN exists.
No doNotGroup needed at either hub — Bristol Temple Meads and Bath Spa are single-layer, GWR-dominated, platforms distinguished by route not operator.

Boundary through-running stations (Chepstow, Gloucester, Westbury, Taunton) are catalogued flat, NOT merge points — D2 de-dup concern for future South Wales / West Midlands / Solent / Thames Valley / Southwest packs, not built here.
